rule: Patterns are composition/persuasion grammars tied to a customer decision, not fixed HTML components. Production-candidate status requires later multi-company validation.

patterns.suitable_customer_business_moment: Customer sees themselves before category explanation
incompatible_conditions: customer must first inspect a hard proof/condition
recognition copy would imply an unsupported pain
patterns.desktop_behavior: media may carry environmental authority; copy need not dominate
patterns.mobile_re_art_direction_principle: first viewport retains thesis and authority rather than simply stacking
patterns.template_risk_if_overused: HIGH if repeated as giant-heading + media split

patterns.suitable_customer_business_moment: Proof or mechanism deserves first authority
incompatible_conditions: proof is unverified or not decision-relevant
patterns.desktop_behavior: proof can dominate spatially; headline frames evidence
patterns.template_risk_if_overused: MEDIUM; fails when reduced to badge strip

patterns.suitable_customer_business_moment: Customer needs routing before persuasion can progress
incompatible_conditions: single offer with no genuine choice problem
patterns.desktop_behavior: choice field behaves as authored composition, not equal cards
patterns.template_risk_if_overused: VERY HIGH if reduced to three equal cards

patterns.suitable_customer_business_moment: Customer needs to know what is known, covered or still unresolved
patterns.template_risk_if_overused: LOW when evidence-specific; HIGH when every case uses same ledger styling

patterns.suitable_customer_business_moment: Different doubts arise at different decisions
incompatible_conditions: proof would be repetitive or disconnected from claims
patterns.desktop_behavior: proof is embedded at causal decision points
patterns.mobile_re_art_direction_principle: keep proof adjacent to the claim/question it resolves

patterns.suitable_customer_business_moment: Customer needs to recognize a concrete occasion/problem
incompatible_conditions: pain framing would exaggerate or fabricate customer condition
patterns.desktop_behavior: one tension per scene; visual supports occasion

patterns.suitable_customer_business_moment: Company-specific reason/process explains why service is different or credible
incompatible_conditions: story depends on invented founder/process facts
patterns.desktop_behavior: authority changes through causal beats rather than long prose column
patterns.mobile_re_art_direction_principle: break into causal beats, not generic timeline cards

patterns.suitable_customer_business_moment: Multiple services become clearer through customer intent/state
incompatible_conditions: service distinctions are operational rather than customer-meaningful
patterns.desktop_behavior: different services need not receive identical modules
patterns.mobile_re_art_direction_principle: route may become sequential while preserving decision logic
patterns.template_risk_if_overused: HIGH if equal cards repeat across cases

patterns.suitable_customer_business_moment: Procedure reduces uncertainty and proves operational competence
incompatible_conditions: process details are unknown or not material to decision
verified human asset/evidence unavailable for direct representation
patterns.media_requirements: verified owner/staff media for direct use
patterns.desktop_behavior: person and context relationship, not portrait decoration
patterns.template_risk_if_overused: VERY HIGH plus fabrication risk if human evidence is unavailable

incompatible_conditions: media is generic stock with no causal role
patterns.mobile_re_art_direction_principle: re-crop or foreground media to preserve sensory authority
patterns.template_risk_if_overused: HIGH if used as stock-image costume

patterns.suitable_customer_business_moment: Price/offer becomes meaningful after value/risk is understood
incompatible_conditions: price/conditions unavailable or customer is not ready to compare
patterns.desktop_behavior: price is decision authority; surrounding design quiets
patterns.mobile_re_art_direction_principle: restructure comparison rather than shrinking table

patterns.suitable_customer_business_moment: Next action should match resolved uncertainty and current readiness
incompatible_conditions: CTA requires a commitment not supported by customer state/evidence
patterns.desktop_behavior: CTA treatment follows state, not fixed page position
patterns.mobile_re_art_direction_principle: keep action close to the objection/decision it resolves
patterns.template_risk_if_overused: HIGH if same sticky/button pattern is universal

incompatible_conditions: ending should instead provide emotional closure
patterns.desktop_behavior: late-page authority may be utility/evidence rather than Hero echo
patterns.mobile_re_art_direction_principle: keep final state clear and low-friction
patterns.template_risk_if_overused: HIGH if FAQ -> colored CTA box -> footer repeats

patterns.suitable_customer_business_moment: Evidence path is complete and final emotional/state payoff matters
incompatible_conditions: customer still lacks essential proof or action clarity
patterns.desktop_behavior: ending may open/relax spatially without copying Hero
